prompt: What change most likely caused the incident on 2026-07-14, and what resolved it? Use the workspace files.

messages.content: You are a helpful assistant with access to tools. When you need information from the workspace, or need to run a command, call the appropriate tool. Once you have enough information to answer, reply directly with the answer in plain text and do NOT call any more tools.
What change most likely caused the incident on 2026-07-14, and what resolved it? Use the workspace files.

events.reply:
The incident was almost certainly caused by **deploy v3.2.1 at 09:05 UTC on 2026-07-14**, which switched the session cache from in-memory to Redis. The API error rate spiked to 30% with p99 latency of 8s just 7 minutes later, at 09:12 UTC — consistent with the app now depending on a Redis round-trip (added latency / connection failures) for session lookups.

It was resolved by **deploy v3.2.2 at 10:02 UTC**, which rolled back v3.2.1 and reverted the session cache to in-memory. Error rates returned to normal at 10:07 UTC, about 5 minutes after the rollback.

The preceding v3.2.0 deploy (2026-07-13, dependency bumps only) ran fine for over 16 hours before the incident, so it's an unlikely cause.

checks.name: not contains "caused by the dependency bumps"
